responsibility: Implements C++ ABI name mangling for GCC, primarily following the Itanium/IA64 C++ ABI. It encodes declarations, types, templates, thunks, vtables, VTTs, guard variables, TLS wrappers, RTTI objects, module-related substitutions, and other ABI-visible entities into linkage names, while also handling ABI-version compatibility warnings and the substitution machinery used to compress repeated mangling components.
